summary: Gold Resource Corporation, the registrant, is the target in a merger with Goldgroup Mining Inc. via a wholly owned subsidiary, Goldgroup Merger Sub. The arrangement agreement was amended on May 15, 2026 to allow a flexible consolidation ratio for Goldgroup shares pre-closing, subject to TSXV approval, to facilitate a NYSE American listing post-merger. The merger, structured as a reverse triangular merger under an arrangement agreement, positions Gold Resource to become a wholly owned subsidiary of Goldgroup. The filing notes no specific price per share, premium, or timeline. Watch for TSXV and NYSE listing approval as key regulatory milestones; risk-arbitrage hinges on final consolidation ratio and exchange listing clearance.
